cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: the previous coupon date before settlement, semiannual
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result as the date 15-Nov-10. The function is documented to return "a number that represents the previous coupon date", and 2010-11-15 is serial 40497 in the 1900 date system (days since the 1899-12-30 epoch, confirmed by Python date arithmetic). Setup serials are the dates Microsoft's page prints: 40568 = 2011-01-25 (settlement), 40862 = 2011-11-15 (maturity), frequency 2 (semiannual), basis 1 (actual/actual). Counting coupon dates back from maturity in six-month steps gives 2011-11-15, 2011-05-15, 2010-11-15, so the settlement date falls in the coupon period 2010-11-15 to 2011-05-15, so the coupon date on or before 2011-01-25 is 2010-11-15

cases.description: The same bond settled on 2011-06-01, one coupon period later
cases.expected_note: Moving the settlement date past the 2011-05-15 coupon must move the previous coupon date forward to 2011-05-15 = serial 40678. This discriminates the settlement argument: the documented example and this case differ only in settlement and must return different coupon dates
